title: maclura tinctoria
intro: Maclura tinctoria, commonly known as Osage orange, is a plant species native to North America, known for its distinctive orange-yellow fruit and thorny branches. The health benefits of Maclura tinctoria include its potential to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and act as an antimicrobial agent, making it a valuable plant in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Maclura tinctoria include its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Maclura tinctoria include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
